## 1d26c382ab68

**Reproduced defect: the selected task test is not portable, although no generator-semantic issue was found.** Generator SHA-256 `93e88ca1ef2cfcda83fb883320eba8c53dcd88eb47c9a4f00d19c0859d769a95`; rule pin `e4dd26fbc01b`.

The complete 12-stage battery passed with 12 green stages and no advisory or failure (`checks/audit/1d26c382ab68/battery/result.json`). I additionally sampled 600 generated inputs across default/easy/medium/hard: all 600 were unique, non-identity, self-validating scenes; all three match slots, all four rotations, all six candidate colors, and all three linked dimension profiles appeared; every scene retained a reflection distractor. The probe found zero structural failures (`checks/audit/1d26c382ab68/probe.json`). I did not find a fixed-position, fixed-rotation, reflection-accepting, identity, or malformed-scene shortcut in those checks.

However, the required portable task-test runtime failed 1 of 14 tests. `test_rule_hash_and_canonical_inputs_are_pinned` constructs `ROOT` from the generator test directory and then opens `ROOT / "data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl"`, which becomes `generators/1d26c382ab68/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`; that file is not present in the portable runtime. The other 13 tests passed. Evidence: `checks/audit/1d26c382ab68/task-tests/result.json`. This should use the bundled `reviewer_support.canonical_pairs(..., root=find_root(__file__))` helper instead of a task-relative canonical path. No target files were changed.
